scale: Each criterion scored 0, 1, or 2. Correctness is NOT in this rubric — it is decided by running the code. Score only what execution cannot see. Do not reward an answer for being correct, and do not penalise it for being wrong; that is already counted.

criteria.text: The change is minimal and targeted. Rewriting untouched code, reformatting, or renaming beyond what the task required scores 0 — a large diff is a review cost even when it works.
The solution follows the conventions visible in the surrounding code — error style, export style, naming, module layout — whether or not any instruction stated them.
No dependency was added, no build step introduced, and no file created that the task did not require.
Edge cases beyond the ones the tests name are handled, or their omission is explicitly noted. Passing the given tests by special-casing their exact inputs scores 0.
Any explanation given is accurate about what was changed and why. An explanation that misdescribes the diff scores 0.
Comments, where added, explain why rather than restating what the line does.
